name: path-utils
description: Essential path manipulation utilities from MSYS2 and MinGW toolchain

basename.description: Extract filename component from file path by removing directory prefix

convert.description: Path format converter between Windows and UNIX-style paths

cygpath.description: Convert between MSYS2/Cygwin and Windows path formats with comprehensive options

dirname.description: Extract directory component from file path by removing filename suffix

hardlink.description: Create hard links to files for space-efficient file duplication
hardlink.usage:
hardlink source.txt target.txt
hardlink -n source.txt
hardlink -v source.txt backup.txt

link.description: Create file links with extended options and validation
link.usage:
link -s source.txt symlink.txt
link -f source.txt hardlink.txt
link -v source.txt target.txt

ln.description: UNIX-style link creator for symbolic and hard links with standard options
ln.usage:
ln -s /path/to/file symlink
ln file1.txt file2.txt
ln -sf new_target existing_link

pathchk.description: Validate file path names for portability and system compatibility

readlink.description: Read and resolve symbolic links to display target paths
readlink.usage:
readlink symlink.txt
readlink -f symlink.txt
readlink -e symlink.txt

realpath.description: Resolve absolute canonical path by following all symbolic links

unlink.description: Remove single file or symbolic link using UNIX-style unlink operation

windmc.description: Windows Message Compiler for creating message resource files from text definitions
windmc.usage:
windmc messages.mc
windmc -h include_dir messages.mc
windmc -r res_dir messages.mc

windres.description: Windows Resource Compiler for converting resource files to object format
windres.usage:
windres resource.rc resource.o
windres -i input.rc -o output.o
windres --define MACRO=VALUE resource.rc
